lăpăthum , i, n., and lăpăthus , i, f. (m., Lucil.;
I. v. infra . Ante-class. collat. form lăpăthĭum , ii, Varr. ap. Non. 550, 17; id. L. L. 5, § 103 Müll.), n., = λάπαθον or λάπαθος, sorrel.—Form lapathum, Plin. 20, 21, 85, § 231.—Form lapathus, Col. poët. 10, 373.—In masc., Lucil. ap. Cic. Fin. 2, 8, 24.—In a dub. form: “lapathi brevis herba,” Hor. S. 2, 4, 29 ; id. Epod. 2, 57.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
